colors.name: Midnight Canvas
colors.role: Page background, hero background, primary canvas - deep near-black navy that absorbs the eye and makes artwork pop

colors.name: Abyss
colors.role: Deepest surface layer, navigation background - the near-pure black undercarriage beneath the canvas

colors.name: Eclipse
colors.role: Footer background, alternate dark surface - slightly warmer dark for depth variation

colors.name: Carbon
colors.role: Elevated dark surface - used for cards or panels sitting above the canvas

colors.name: Slate Veil
colors.role: Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Luminous
colors.role: Primary text, heading text, icon fills, link text, button labels - the dominant light element across the interface

colors.name: Pearl
colors.role: Border color used at scale (hairs, dividers, card edges) - the structural skeleton of the UI

colors.name: Mist
colors.role: Body text, secondary text, helper copy - muted gray for non-primary reading

colors.name: Fog
colors.role: List text, icon fills, secondary metadata - the lightest level of secondary text

colors.name: Deep Ink
colors.role: Gray text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Onyx Label
colors.role: Dark text for inverted or high-contrast button labels on light fills

colors.name: Electric Cyan
colors.role: Primary CTA buttons (SIGN UP NOW, plan tier cards) - the sole chromatic action color; neon-cyan against the void creates cinema-marquee urgency

colors.name: Teal Pulse
colors.role: Accent text, promotional price highlights ( 4.99), link emphasis, body emphasis - the slightly darker teal sibling used for inline chromatic moments that aren't buttons

fonts.name: Inspire
fonts.role: Sole typeface across the entire interface - headings, body, buttons, labels, nav. The single-font commitment is deliberate: it means Inspire must carry both 12px micro-labels and 40px display moments without losing character. Use 700 for headings, price, and emphasis; 400 for everything else.

components.name: Cyan CTA Button
components.role: Primary conversion action - sign up, subscribe, plan selection

components.name: Plan Tier Card
components.role: Subscription option display (Standard with Ads, Standard, Premium)

components.name: Content Tile Card
components.role: Movie/series poster card in carousels and grids

components.name: Top 10 Ranked Card
components.role: Hero content ranking with large numeral overlay

components.name: Feature Comparison Row
components.role: Plan comparison table - concurrent streams, Dolby Atmos, ads, etc.

components.name: Section Heading
components.role: Content section title (e.g., 'Top 10 Today', 'Choose your plan', 'Watch the way you want')

components.name: Hero Pricing Banner
components.role: Central conversion offer overlay on poster-grid background

components.name: Footer
components.role: Legal links, fine print, bottom-of-page content

components.name: Promotional Price Highlight
components.role: Strikethrough or savings callout in pricing contexts

do: Use #33ddff (Electric Cyan) exclusively for filled CTA buttons and active plan tier cards - no other fills should carry this color
Keep all text on the dark canvas in #fafafa for primary, #b7b8bd for secondary, #c0c0c0 for tertiary - never use a chromatic color for body text
Use Teal Pulse (#02d6e8) for inline emphasis, savings callouts, and informational highlights - not for buttons
Apply Inspire at all sizes with the same 0.025em letter-spacing - do not tighten tracking on display sizes
Use 12px border-radius for all buttons and content cards; 8px for inputs and nav elements
Let poster artwork occupy the full card area - never wrap posters in visible card frames, borders, or shadows
Center-align section headings and let generous 48-64px vertical space create the cadence between content rails
doNot: Do not introduce additional accent colors - the system is monochrome with one cyan and one teal; any other chromatic is off-system
Do not apply box-shadows to cards, buttons, or content tiles - the design uses flat color and borders for structure, not elevation
Do not use cyan (#33ddff) for non-action text, icons, or decorative elements - reserve it strictly for filled buttons
Do not override the positive letter-spacing on large headings - 0.025em at 40px produces 1px tracking, which is the intended whisper-not-shout scale
Do not place light text on cyan fills without testing contrast - use #02172a (Deep Ink) for dark text on cyan, not #17171c or pure black
Do not add background fills to content poster cards - the artwork is the card; adding a frame reduces the cinematic effect
Do not use a secondary typeface for display or hero moments - Inspire carries the full type scale, from 12px captions to 40px headings
